review_method: AI-assisted reading of the named primary-source sections. Empirical results are reported by the papers and were not independently reproduced.

records.finding: Low-precision errors injected at several sites can produce QK spectral runaway. QK-local interventions and direction-matched controls support a shared failure channel; QK-Guard activates per-head normalization after a monitored logit threshold.
records.relevance: Connects attention saturation, QK geometry, numerical precision, and training stability to the survey's discussion of architectural interventions.
records.limits: The tested failures are controlled low-precision training faults. The study does not establish persistent semantic-independent sink positions in all models, and a large QK norm alone is not a sufficient failure detector.
records.taxonomy_note: Retained as broader concentration/stability evidence. Existing attention-sink method categories are not inferred from QK normalization alone.

records.finding: SpecFormer softens input singular values, computes Q/K from softened features, and adds a learned spectral residual term for recommendation. Effective-rank measurements characterize its collapse criterion.
records.relevance: Useful related evidence on how embedding spectra and attention-map degeneration interact, including interventions beyond language and vision models.
records.limits: Its attention-collapse definition includes overly smoothed as well as sparse maps. Low rank is not by itself proof of a query-independent sink or low per-query entropy.
records.taxonomy_note: Retained in the broad library with its own collapse definition. Spectral terminology does not automatically imply Geometric Anchoring.

records.finding: The paper diagnoses BLOOM heads with BOS mass and attention entropy, then reinitializes selected Q/K/V projections, zeroes their output projections, and trains them while masking gradients of the remaining parameters.
records.relevance: Directly relevant to BOS concentration and post-training repair. A concrete example of model adaptation that reduces a learned attention pathology.
records.limits: Full repair is evaluated only on BLOOM-1b7. Head-recovery thresholds are architecture-dependent, corpus effects remain confounded, and generation evaluation is limited.
records.taxonomy_note: Relevant to Other Mitigation Techniques and Model Tuning; any future formal row should retain that training is required rather than describe it as a training-free edit.

records.finding: TQL measures increasingly concentrated attention in larger Transformer Q-functions and trains with attention-entropy losses using adaptive layer-wise and VALUE-token coefficients.
records.relevance: Broadens the concentration discussion to reinforcement-learning value networks and provides evidence on entropy-guided training interventions.
records.limits: The experiments concern small offline-RL critics and do not show that their concentrated tokens implement the same mechanisms as LLM sinks. Entropy regularization, modality embeddings, and policy extraction contribute to the evaluated system.
records.taxonomy_note: Retained as related entropy-control evidence. The learnable entropy coefficient is not an attention-logit bias and is not a learnable sink token.
